meta.name: Route medical info requests and safety events with Claude and Slack

parameters.content:
## AI Medical Information Request Router

Takes incoming HCP/patient medical-information questions, classifies topic/urgency/complexity, retrieves approved knowledge sources, and either sends a fully-sourced automated reply for standard questions or routes the case to the right medical-information team — with a hard, always-on fail-safe that sends any possible adverse event or safety signal straight to Drug Safety, bypassing the normal routing entirely.

### How it works
1. Webhook - Medical Info Request Submitted receives the question, requester type (HCP/patient), product, and contact details.
2. Claude classifies the request: topic category, urgency, complexity (Standard vs Complex), and whether it looks like a possible adverse event or safety signal.
3. IF - Adverse Event or Safety Signal Detected? is checked FIRST and independently of everything else — any flagged case goes straight to an urgent Pharmacovigilance case + immediate Drug Safety alert, no knowledge retrieval, no auto-answer path.
4. Everything else proceeds to knowledge retrieval: HTTP - Search Approved Knowledge Base pulls matching approved content, and Claude drafts an answer strictly from those retrieved sources, citing them and flagging if it can't fully answer.
5. A routing node decides whether the request qualifies for an automated reply (Standard complexity, Routine urgency, sufficient approved-source coverage, and a complete draft) or needs to be escalated to a specific medical-information team based on topic.
6. Auto-answerable requests get emailed the sourced answer directly. Escalated requests get a case opened and an alert posted to the right team's channel.
7. All three paths (safety, auto-answered, escalated) converge and are logged to the compliance log for audit purposes.

### Setup
1. Import this workflow into n8n and activate it.
2. Add credentials: your approved medical-information knowledge base API, your case/ticketing system API (used for both safety cases and MI cases), Anthropic Claude, Slack, and your email/SMTP provider.
3. Edit Set - Config: knowledge base URL, case system URLs, team routing map (topic → team/Slack channel), and default channels.
4. Run once with a sample request to confirm classification, retrieval, drafting, and routing all work end to end before activating for real traffic.

## Stage 1: Intake & AI Classification

- **Webhook - Medical Info Request Submitted** — receives the incoming HCP/patient question, requester type, product, and contact details.
- **Set - Config** — central place for the approved knowledge base, case/ticketing, and team routing settings.
- **Anthropic - Classification & Response Model** — the Claude model shared by the classification and drafting agents. 🔑
- **AI Agent - Classify Medical Information Request** — classifies topic, urgency, complexity, and flags possible adverse events/safety signals.
- **JS - Parse Classification Output** — safely parses Claude's classification, defaulting to a safety flag if parsing fails.

## Stage 2: Safety Fail-Safe & Approved Knowledge Retrieval

- **IF - Adverse Event or Safety Signal Detected?** — branches straight to Drug Safety if the classifier flagged a possible safety issue.
- **HTTP - Create Urgent Safety Case (Pharmacovigilance)** — opens an urgent case in the safety/pharmacovigilance system. 🔑
- **Slack - Alert Drug Safety Team (Immediate)** — pages the Drug Safety team right away for possible adverse events. 🔑
- **HTTP - Search Approved Knowledge Base** — retrieves matching approved medical-information content for the question. 🔑
- **JS - Evaluate Knowledge Base Coverage** — checks whether the retrieved sources sufficiently cover the question.
- **AI Agent - Draft Response from Approved Sources** — drafts an answer strictly from the retrieved approved sources, citing them.
- **JS - Parse Draft Response** — safely parses the drafted answer and whether it fully answers the question.

## Stage 3: Routing, Delivery & Logging

- **JS - Determine Routing Team & Channel** — decides whether the request can be auto-answered and which MI team/channel it should escalate to.
- **Switch - Route by Resolution Path** — routes to an automated reply, or escalates to the medical-information team.
- **Email - Send Approved Answer to Requester** — sends the approved-sources answer directly to the requester. 🔑
- **HTTP - Create Medical Information Case (Escalated)** — opens a case for the MI team with the classification and draft answer for reference. 🔑
- **Slack - Alert Medical Information Team** — notifies the routed team/channel that a case needs their attention. 🔑
- **Merge - Combine Resolution Branches** — merges the safety, auto-answer, and escalation paths back into one flow.
- **HTTP - Log Request to MI Compliance Log** — records the request, classification, and outcome for audit purposes. 🔑
